What counts as a tie: the eleven kinds of record

Each of the 452 members with a record counts once in the chamber. Each bar counts all serving members with that kind of record. The bars can overlap and include members from either seat group. 119 of 452 have only records of what third parties did.

I · The arrival

Gifts reached 10 sitting members by the end of 2024 and 199 by Sept. 2026.

Anthropic employees gave $6.1M of their own money, 92% of it in 2026. Its PAC gave $226K, reaching 18 members with no employee gift on file.

II · The bigger money

Anthropic announced $40.0M for Public First Action.
